scripts.upgrade:backend: cd backend && go get -u github.com/gofiber/fiber/v3@latest && go mod tidy
scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan,magenta" -n "backend,frontend" "cd backend && air" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:air: npx -y concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan,magenta" -n "backend,frontend" "cd backend && air" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:no-air: npx -y concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan,magenta" -n "backend,frontend" "cd backend && go run main.go" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && go build -o bin/server main.go
